title: Advanced thyroid carcinomas: neural network analysis of ultrasonographic characteristics.
summary: The source-specific clinical question is whether advanced carcinoma has distinctive ultrasound/clinical features; NN evaluates that finding against histopathology. This qualifies narrowly as retrospective diagnostic validation, not deployment or benefit.
ai_technology: retrospective n=96 histologically confirmed thyroid cancers (32 advanced, 32 non-advanced PTC, 32 non-advanced FTC); nine sonographic/clinical inputs to a neural network proof-of-concept. evidence.tested: retrospective n=96 histologically confirmed thyroid cancers (32 advanced, 32 non-advanced PTC, 32 non-advanced FTC); nine sonographic/clinical inputs to a neural network proof-of-concept. Results characterize advanced tumors (including size/irregularity patterns) and report classification performance (accuracy 84.4%, CI 75.5–91). Small, single-center retrospective cohort; authors call for prospective multicenter work.
